description_en: Retrieves a specific service credential of a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 获取RAM用户的某个服务凭证
kebab_example: aliyun ims get-service-credential --service-credential-id SC0000000000000000 --user-principal-name test@example.onaliyun.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetServiceCredential

parameters.help_en:
The logon name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
If not specified, the service credential of the identity that invokes the current operation is retrieved
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户登录名称。
不指定表示获取当前调用身份下的服务凭证
parameters.name: user_principal_name
